authorization_basis: Explicit user authorization in the active conversation on 2026-09-23 for pinned S01-2 feature extraction and the existing frozen geometry analysis.

backbone.identity_check: SHA-256 of sorted named state tensors including name, dtype, shape, and exact tensor bytes, before extraction and after extraction plus deterministic repeats; hashes must be identical.

input_protocol.source: sealed S01-2 corpus and sealed S01-2A token IDs/offsets
input_protocol.alignment_assignments: read exact seven-view position assignments from sealed S01-2C alignment-assignments-v01.jsonl; do not recompute token-span ownership
input_protocol.processing: single event per forward call, exact sequence length, no padding, no mixed-length batches, no added inputs, no tokenizer invocation

views.pooling: mean of final-layer hidden states over all positions [0, sequence_length), including special-token positions
mean at the exact S01-2C sorted deduplicated context token positions
mean at the exact S01-2C sorted deduplicated entity token positions
mean at the exact S01-2C sorted deduplicated relation token positions
concatenate V3, V4, V5 in that order

serialization.layout: one contiguous row-major binary file per view, event order identical across views and to the sealed corpus
serialization.row_manifest: one JSONL row per event, with corpus and tokenizer identities, all token IDs and offsets, position assignments, feature shapes and per-view feature SHA-256 values

determinism.sample_selection: first 256 A/C/E/P event rows in sealed corpus order
determinism.procedure: re-read and match the stored token IDs, token offsets, sequence length, and S01-2C view positions for the fixed rows; recompute each event in a separate forward call; compare every view shape and serialized feature byte exactly to the first-pass cache

geometry.input: only the sealed feature cache and the sealed S01-2 counterfactual corpus
geometry.arithmetic: convert stored float32 rows to float64 before subtraction, norms, dot products, cosine, and summaries

forbidden: view selection, ranking, rescue criteria, pooling/layer/normalization search
corpus changes, tokenization, span ownership reinterpretation, or backbone writes
